intent: Sessions tiles must mean what their labels say. SessionInsights receives only the 50-row page and computes total: sessions.length, so the tile labelled TOTAL showed 50 against 35,790 real sessions, contradicting the page header directly above it. ACTIVE, MESSAGES and CLI are page-scoped too; only TOTAL was caught because it had a contradicting number beside it. The real COUNT(*) is ALREADY in the payload and already feeds the header; it is simply never passed to the tiles. Operator ruled 2026-08-26: real totals for all four, which needs one new aggregate (GROUP BY status, source plus SUM(message_count)) in the sessions repository. CHECK THE INDEX before shipping, this runs against 35k rows; if the aggregate is slow, relabel the three as page-scoped rather than ship a slow page. SQL goes in the repository file: sql-outside-repository is at zero and stays there. Source: the operator's live Hermes QA pass on dev@43d16c30, 2026-08-26; root cause traced and independently re-verified. Not a regression from the consolidation work.
